content_text: A couple of days ago i read on Facebook that it’s possible that Roger will be the DoP on Sam Mendes’ Beatles movies . I don’t know if it’s true (it looked like more a rumour than a real cinema news, actually) and i don’t think Roger will announce his present and future projects here or around the web (you know, privacy, NDAs, contracts, etc etc.),  but perhaps it’s the project you remember?
